inputs.text: One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is J: taking either of them high takes that output to 10V.
One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is K: taking either of them high takes that output to 10V.
One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is L: taking either of them high takes that output to 10V.
One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is M: taking either of them high takes that output to 10V.

outputs.text: 10V while either A or B is high, 0V while both are low.
10V while either C or D is high, 0V while both are low.
10V while either E or F is high, 0V while both are low.
10V while either G or H is high, 0V while both are low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
